name: Rose Pamela Cooper
source: Kind and caring, Rose has the patience to rival a saint, considering she had to train many other estate agents with Isabella being the last of the lot. The woman is kind enough that she’s shared her lunch with Isabella in her early years, when she is unable to make frequent sales. She’s one of BRC’s best agent and has a great knack for business, a fact which may surprise people.
